definitions.explanation: A basket provided by stores for customers to carry items while shopping, typically placed near the entrance.

examples.japanese: {買|か}い{物|もの}かご⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧。
{買|か}い{物|もの}かご⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧いっぱいになった。
{買|か}い{物|もの}かご⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦カート→カート：10265_kaato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}せる→乗せる：01972_noseru⟧。
examples.english: Put the shopping basket on the cart.

notes:
USAGE:
At a Japanese supermarket checkout, the cashier scans each item and moves it into a second, empty basket (⟦レジ→レジ：00879_reji⟧かご); you then carry that basket to a separate counter and pack your bags yourself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {買|か}い{物|もの}かご⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to carry a shopping basket)
- {買|か}い{物|もの}かご⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (to put in the shopping basket)
- {買|か}い{物|もの}かご⟦{置|お}き{場|ば}→置き場：22477_okiba⟧ (shopping basket station)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦カート→カート：10265_kaato⟧: shopping cart
- ⟦レジ→レジ：00879_reji⟧かご: checkout basket
- ⟦マイバッグ→マイバッグ：09837_maibaggu⟧: reusable bag
